warehouse/31270.htm.text: Freighter Stefano: Don't take anything into battle you don't actually need -- it'll just slow you down! Instead, take advantage of our services to deposit your valuables in our warehouse. You won't find a safer, more cost-effective deal!

warehouse/31270-noteach.htm.text: Freighter Stefano: Sorry, friend, but I only teach Dwarven Fighters, Scavengers and Bounty Hunters. I'm sure someone else can give you what you need...

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/1-01.htm.text: Warehouse Freightman Stefano: Justin sent you here? Ah...I think I know why... Justin has pestered me for months now, but transporting cell tissues isn't easy.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/1-03.htm.text: Warehouse Freightman Stefano: I see that you've managed to find some icicles. Very good! Now all we need to do is give the cell tissues a special low temperature treatment to preserve them during the journey. It might take a while -- do you mind waiting?

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/1-02.htm.text: Warehouse Freightman Stefano: If you get Ice Crystals from Chef Jeremy, then I can treat those cells for Justin.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/1-04.htm.text: Warehouse Freightman Stefano: Hurry and take those cell tissues to Justin before they thaw.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/1-05.htm.text: Warehouse Freightman Stefano: The cell tissues that Justin needs are very fragile, and if they are less than perfect they are completely unusable. It is possible to transport them using a special low temperature treatment, but we will need icicles for the procedure. Bring me the icicles and I'll be…

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/1-06.htm.text: Warehouse Freightman Stefano: Phew! All ready, at last. Here are the temperature-treated cell tissues. Hurry and take them to Justin before they thaw.
